title: Create an Entity
content: Steps to create a new reusable entity in TYT Platform v2.

items.title: Name it generically
items.what: Pick a domain name (e.g., movement, camera, loader)
items.how: Use lowercase file names; no project keywords

items.title: Place under entity/
items.how: Keep logic pure; no DOM in shared entities unless UI domain

items.title: Document intent (VN)
items.what: Add short VN comment for intent/constraints
